content: I would rather die of passion than of boredom.
author: Vincent van Gogh
sourceWork: The Letters of Vincent van Gogh to Theo
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. True art and creative work are not about clever technique; they demand total emotional skin in the game. When you create safely to please an audience or avoid criticism, the work feels hollow and bloodless.

Vincent van Gogh understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Pouring your genuine spirit, vulnerability, and raw lived experience into what you make is what gives it enduring life. The work that resonates across centuries is always the work created with unapologetic personal truth.
reflectionPrompt: What creative idea or authentic voice have you held inside, and what small step can you take to express it?
